title: Snow Globe overlay protocol, version 1
description: Messages from the Rust core to the overlay webview (the root), and from the webview to the core ($defs.outbound), PRD sections 5, 6.3 and 10.3. Generated from app/src/overlay/protocol.ts; do not edit by hand. Rules no schema states, which parseInbound() also enforces: timestamps are real instants, time zones are known IANA zones, the locale is a known tag, and a query's valid_time and valid_time_utc are the same instant. Transport rules: messages arrive in send order on one channel, query_gen rises by one per key press from 1, and diagnostics never carry transcript text.
